summary: Verified the Vite allowedHosts fix only (frontend, no login). Preview URL root returns HTTP 200 with real SSR HTML (title 'CashGPT — Earn real rewards...'), and contains no 'Blocked request' / 'is not allowed' text. Also sent arbitrary Host headers (earn-methods-hero.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud via proxy port 3000, and random-weird-host.example.dev directly to port 8080) — both returned 200 with no host-block page. Browser render at 390x844 loads the public Sign-in route cleanly (title 'Sign in — CashGPT'), Vite HMR client connected, no console errors. Authenticated home screen ('Cash Out Your Way') was NOT tested as instructed (no credentials / Supabase auth unavailable).
critical_code_review_comments: vite.config.ts uses `server.allowedHosts: true` which is acceptable for the preview/dev sandbox; ensure it is not relied upon in a production deployment where an explicit allowlist is safer.
test_credentials: None available in pod; /app/memory not containing usable login credentials — authenticated routes untestable
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flat Vite/TanStack app at /app root (not /app/frontend). Dev server on 8080, node /tmp/proxy.js forwards 3000->8080, ingress maps 3000. Preview: https://featured-ui-upgrade.preview.emergentagent.com. Root redirects to public /sign-in route. Redesigned 'Cash Out Your Way' section (data-testid=cash-out-section, payout-method-paypal/crypto/giftcards, need-help-card) remains unverified — needs Supabase test user.
rca_of_the_issue: Vite 5+ rejects requests whose Host header is not in server.allowedHosts. Adding `vite: { server: { allowedHosts: true } }` to the @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config defineConfig disables the host check; confirmed by 200 responses with arbitrary Host headers.
